normalization: The Archive's OCR text layers (_djvu.txt), line endings normalized; the scans are held by reference with the Archive's md5. The OCR is kept as made, with line endings normalized. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings and say where those differ from the printed page.
scope: Two books entire in the Archive's OCR (Fraktur, read with errors). The System sets out Plato's life, then the chronological order of the writings, then the system extracted from them; the second volume of the Geschichte gives Plato's writings and philosophy again in the history's frame, and is the volume Hegel's notes to the lectures on Plato cite as Tennemann B. II (32/10).
verified_loci: System I, part two: on the chronological order of the Platonic writings — 'Ueber die Zeitfolge der Platonifchen Schriften.' (the page reads Platonischen with a long s; the OCR reads Platonifchen)

System I: it matters for no writer when he made a given writing, least of all for Plato — 'Schrift verfertiger hat, am allerwenigſten aber beim' (the page reads verfertiget; the OCR reads verfertiger)
Geschichte II: the running head over the account of Plato's writings and philosophy — 'Platons Schriften und Philoſophie.'
why_seated: Tennemann is the reader Hegel faults for extracting the determinations of the dialogues as a finished system and losing their movement. The study reads the books Hegel read.
